Questions

What does “SaaS product development” cost?
At Qilich the MVP costs $25,000–50,000 (UZS 300–605 mln) and the full version $60,000–150,000 (UZS 720–1,805 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “SaaS product development” take?
Qilich builds the MVP in 10–16 weeks and the full version in 24–40 weeks.
What do we need to provide for “SaaS product development”?
Domain and hosting access; texts, photos and the logo; one person who makes the decisions.

Prefer to talk? Call +998 97 270 70 07 or send Qilich an enquiry.
